text: Decision 2026-10-09 (owner asked for the better technical approach): keep AoiSet[U] keyed by AoiId and amend PRD RA-1 and the v1.1 section. Rationale: region identity and entity identity differ (an entity may own several regions, move across frames, persist across scenes), so entity keying belongs in a separate validated relation (e.g. EntityBinding[E]: AoiId <-> E, beside Construal) that vwp can add after 1.0 as a binary-compatible addition. Parameterising AoiSet[U, E] would push E through dwell, reading, Session, RecordingPlan, diagnostics and conditional codecs before the compatibility freeze. Remaining: amend PRD.md RA-1/RA-9 and eyes4s.md, then close.
